name: scaffold-hbar-clip-wallet
description: Your own non-custodial wallet on the Clip Wallet kit, on every platform from one clip.config.ts: a branded browser extension, a desktop app (macOS, Windows, Linux) and a phone app (iOS, Android) (14 network families, 1Mask for every dapp, decoded approvals, a security floor that can't be switched off), plus a Scaffold-HBAR Next.js dapp that connects to it on Hedera testnet, with the debug page. Testnet by default; mainnet behind a checklist. Same project as `npx create-clip-wallet --scaffold-hbar`.

sections.title: Give the wallet its own identity

steps.label: Name, reverse domain you own, app id, extension key, icons for every platform, listing drafts

steps.text: Same result as `npx create-clip-wallet --scaffold-hbar`. Add --logo logo.png for your own icons and --walletconnect-project-id <id> for your own WalletConnect project.

sections.title: Build and try it on Hedera testnet

steps.text: Or pnpm extension:build and load packages/extension/.output/chrome-mv3 unpacked in chrome://extensions; then create a wallet in it.

steps.label: The phone app (iOS, Android): Metro for a development build
Start the demo dapp (connect, sign, send, /debug)

steps.text: Installers and store builds: pnpm desktop:dist, pnpm mobile:prebuild or EAS; accounts and signing in docs/signing.md.
Listing-submission drafts for your identity are in docs/listings (pnpm wallet:listings regenerates them).
Mainnet stays off until MAINNET.md is done: pnpm wallet:mainnet-check shows what is left.
AGENTS.md has recipes for rebranding, platforms, networks, tokens, routing, security and plugins.
